notes: Overrides QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb with wayland;xcb for the standalone updater window when a Wayland session is available.
Keeps missing QT_QPA_PLATFORM behavior from v1.1.10 by preferring wayland;xcb in Wayland sessions.
Preserves explicitly configured non-xcb Qt platform choices.
Keeps the OpenCV/cv2 Qt plugin path sanitation added in v1.1.8.
Keeps update, rollback, offline bundle, firmware, device protocol, motion, pressure-control, UI behavior, and Model behavior unchanged.
summary: Overrides xcb for the updater window when running in a Wayland desktop session.
validation: Get-ChildItem releases\*.json | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null }
